summary: Accelerate bounded YAML health analysis with safe loader parity

delivery.outcome: Keep bounded health analysis responsive using safe accelerated YAML parsing with equivalent diagnostics; preserve deadlines and propagate timeouts instead of reporting partial success.
nonGoals: No change to8second health deadline, required CI, protected profiles or foreign scope.
No runtime deployment, remote ticket selection edits or test quarantine.

architecture.decision: Use existing safe libyaml loader with pure-Python fallback; qualify output parity and let TimeoutError propagate from both YAML and text parsing.
architecture.rollback: Protected corrective/revert source change; preserve deadlines, authoritative tickets and CI history.

validation.evidence: Compare safe loader outputs on realistic YAML fixtures and whole-repository health summary; prove TimeoutError cannot become partial success; retain exact current-head/base protected verification.
